About the Spoke Shop Monday Road Ride group ride

Monday evening road ride from the Spoke Shop lot on Broadwater. Billings TrailNet lists it as open to all levels and adjustable to who shows up. The shop also lists a Saturday morning urban ride (12 to 16 miles) and a Wednesday mountain bike ride from Zimmerman Trail, April to early October. Confirm on the shop's Facebook page before you go.
